name: immich-mcp
description: Austrian efficiency for Immich photo management - 15 comprehensive tools for Sandra's 2000+ photo library with CLIP smart search, face detection, and automated organization. FastMCP 2.10 server with zero decision paralysis.

tools.name: upload_photos
tools.description: Batch upload photos with metadata detection and duplicate handling

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: CLIP smart search with natural language queries plus metadata search

tools.name: get_photo_info
tools.description: Complete photo metadata including EXIF, people, and album associations

tools.name: organize_photos_by_date
tools.description: Austrian efficiency date-based photo organization with bulk album creation

tools.name: delete_photos
tools.description: Safe photo deletion with trash recovery option

tools.name: create_album
tools.description: Create new photo albums with initial photo selection

tools.name: add_to_album
tools.description: Add photos to existing albums with duplicate detection

tools.name: list_albums
tools.description: List all albums with comprehensive metadata and statistics

tools.name: share_album
tools.description: Generate public share links with permission controls

tools.name: detect_people
tools.description: AI-powered face detection and clustering for people identification

tools.name: tag_person

tools.name: search_by_person
tools.description: Find all photos containing specific people by name

tools.name: get_storage_info
tools.description: Storage usage statistics and performance metrics

tools.name: backup_photos
tools.description: Export photos with metadata preservation and album structure

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Immich server health diagnostics and connection testing

prompts.name: organize_my_photos
prompts.description: Austrian efficiency photo organization with zero decision paralysis
prompts.text: Organize my photo library using Austrian efficiency principles. Analyze my 2000+ photos, detect duplicates, create date-based albums, and eliminate organizational chaos. Provide specific action plan with priority levels - tell me exactly what to do first!

prompts.name: find_photos_of_benny
prompts.description: Smart search for Sandra's beautiful GSD dog Benny
prompts.text: Find all photos of Benny (my beautiful German Shepherd Dog) using CLIP smart search and face detection. Look for golden fur, alert ears, and playful expressions. Group by activities: park play, home relaxation, walks, and training sessions.

prompts.name: backup_strategy_analyzer
prompts.description: Comprehensive backup planning for photo preservation
prompts.text: Analyze my photo library and create Austrian efficiency backup strategy. Calculate storage requirements, identify critical photos, suggest backup schedules, and provide disaster recovery plan for my 2000+ photo collection.

prompts.name: memory_lane_generator
prompts.description: AI-powered photo memory and timeline creation
prompts.text: Create nostalgic photo timelines and memory collections. Find photos from specific time periods, identify significant events, group by people and locations. Generate 'year in review' collections with Austrian storytelling efficiency.

prompts.name: photo_health_checkup
prompts.description: Complete photo library maintenance and optimization
prompts.text: Perform comprehensive health analysis of my Immich photo library. Detect corrupted files, missing metadata, duplicate photos, storage inefficiencies. Provide Austrian efficiency cleanup recommendations with specific action items.

smart_search_enabled.title: Smart Search Enabled
smart_search_enabled.description: Enable CLIP-based smart search for natural language queries

face_detection_enabled.title: Face Detection Enabled
face_detection_enabled.description: Enable automatic face detection and people tagging
